description: This file contains tests for verifying the behavior of callback management and routing strategies in a system, using pytest and asyncio. It specifically tests that the number of callbacks does not increase over time under certain conditions, and includes functions to interact with a mock or real API for configuration and callback status.

methods.name: config_update(session, routing_strategy=None)
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the system configuration for routing strategy by sending a POST request to a specified URL with the given routing strategy parameter.

methods.name: get_active_callbacks(session)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current number of callbacks, alerts, and callback list from the system by sending a GET request.

methods.name: get_current_routing_strategy(session)
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the current routing strategy setting from the system via an API call.

methods.name: test_check_num_callbacks()
methods.description: Pytest-annotated asynchronous test function that verifies the number of callbacks remains stable over repeated checks with delays.

methods.name: test_check_num_callbacks_on_lowest_latency()
methods.description: Pytest-annotated asynchronous test function that changes routing strategy, verifies callback stability over time, and restores the original routing setting.
